C0625.title: Amount Involved Exceeds 6 Billion Yuan! Chongqing Police Crack Credit Card Cash-Out Case Using Repayment App
C0625.summary: In May 2024, Chongqing police cracked a case involving the use of the "Youpin Life" app to create orders for fake commodity transactions and maliciously cash out credit cards. The criminal gang charged high fees through this platform, making over 2 million yuan in profit in a short period, with the total amount of credit card cash-outs reaching 6 billion yuan.
